name: The Earth King
clause: Whenever one or more creatures you control with power 4 or greater attack, search your library for up to that many basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

needs.proposedSignature: { on: 'attacks'; self: false; filter: Filter; oneOrMore: true } plus search.count: Amount
